findings.description: Response.__init__ now reads self.raw.reason, but self.raw is initialized to None in the same constructor, so constructing a bare Response() raises AttributeError.
findings.rationale: Trigger: any code that calls Response() with no raw object, such as a custom adapter or test that builds an empty Response before attaching raw. Mechanism: line 793 evaluates None.reason during __init__ because self.raw is None at that point. Impact: the constructor crashes with AttributeError instead of returning an empty Response, breaking code that previously worked.
